    def numberOfWays(self, s: str, t: str, k: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        n = len(s)
        # find all d in [0, n-1] with rotation of s by d equal to t
        # rotation by d (right by d) gives (s+s)[n-d : 2n-d]; equivalently t occurs in s+s at index n-d.
        # Use KMP to find occurrences of t in s+s (positions 0..n-1 suffice for start index p in [0,n-1]).
        pat = t
        m = len(pat)
        fail = [0] * m
        j = 0
        for i in range(1, m):
            while j > 0 and pat[i] != pat[j]:
                j = fail[j - 1]
            if pat[i] == pat[j]:
                j += 1
            fail[i] = j
        text = s + s
        occ = []
        j = 0
        for i in range(len(text)):
            while j > 0 and text[i] != pat[j]:
                j = fail[j - 1]
            if text[i] == pat[j]:
                j += 1
            if j == m:
                start = i - m + 1
                if start < n:
                    occ.append(start)
                j = fail[j - 1]
        # start p corresponds to shift d = (n - p) % n
        has_zero = False
        nonzero = 0
        for p in occ:
            d = (n - p) % n
            if d == 0:
                has_zero = True
            else:
                nonzero += 1
        inv_n = pow(n, MOD - 2, MOD)
        sign = 1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1
        base = pow(n - 1, k, MOD)
        g = (base - sign) % MOD * inv_n % MOD
        f = (base + (n - 1) * sign) % MOD * inv_n % MOD
        ans = 0
        if has_zero:
            ans += f
        ans += nonzero * g
        return ans % MOD

        n = len(s)
        # find p: smallest p in [0,n) with rot_p(s) == t
        # rot_p(s) = s[n-p:] + s[:n-p]  (suffix of length p moved to front)
        ss = s + s
        p = ss.find(t)

            return 0

        d = n

        pi = [0] * n
        for i in range(1, n):
            j = pi[i - 1]
            while j > 0 and s[i] != s[j]:
                j = pi[j - 1]
            if s[i] == s[j]:
                j += 1
            pi[i] = j
        per = n - pi[-1]
        if n % per == 0:
            d = per
        else:
            d = n
        m = n // d
        inv_n = pow(n, MOD - 2, MOD)
        sign = 1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1

        # rot_i(s) = s[i:] + s[:i]; need (s+s)[i:i+n] == t

            if pat[i] == pat[j]:
                j += 1
            fail[i] = j
        matches = []

        for i in range(len(text)):
            while j > 0 and text[i] != pat[j]:
                j = fail[j - 1]
            if text[i] == pat[j]:
                j += 1
            if j == m:
                matches.append(i - m + 1)
                j = fail[j - 1]
        c = len(matches)
        if c == 0:
            return 0
        inv_n = pow(n, MOD - 2, MOD)
        sign = 1 if k % 2 == 0 else MOD - 1
